notes.title: Gooning Mode + HDR, DLSS, Reflex, FSR2, and XeSS Support + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update adds support for the new Gooning Mode DLC, as well as support for a variety of graphical features, and some bug fixes! Patch notes below!

New Features
-Added support for Gooning Mode DLC
-Added support for HDR (High Dynamic Range) available on supported monitors
-Added support for DLSS and DLAA, this allows Nvidia RTX GPU users to get better performance with AI upscaling
-Added support for Reflex low latency, this reduces input lag for Nvidia GPU users and should be enabled by default if your GPU supports it
-Added support for FSR2 upscaling, this will work on Nvidia, AMD, or Intel GPUs
-Added support for XeSS upscaling, this will work on Nvidia, AMD, or Intel GPUs (Requires launching with the DirectX12 launch option and DirectX 12 compatible GPU)

Bug Fixes
-Fixed lighting issues on the Ruins map
-Performance improvements
